# Noise test vector

`noise-nnpsk0.json` contains the published
`Noise_NNpsk0_25519_ChaChaPoly_SHA256` known-answer vector from
[Cacophony](https://github.com/centromere/cacophony/blob/master/vectors/cacophony.txt),
also distributed in [noiseprotocol's conformance suite](https://github.com/plizonczyk/noiseprotocol/tree/master/tests/vectors).
Its private keys and PSK are public test values and are never used by Pingo's runtime.
The source vectors are dedicated to the public domain under the Unlicense.
